uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Static
passiveEffects.originalDescription: Upon receiving damage: paralyzes all nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). Paralysis from Static decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.
passiveEffects.summary: Upon receiving damage: paralyzes all nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). Paralysis from Static decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.
notes: timing, stacking overflow, refresh behavior, and rounding are unconfirmed unless explicitly stated

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack - Pikachu
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the opposing Pokémon hit. Paralysis from Pikachu's boosted attacks decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

moveEffects.name: Thunder Shock
moveEffects.originalDescription: Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon; damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing those hit. Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Thunderstorm Aerial
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Creates a star-shaped zone of electricity in the designated area for 4s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when created, then damaging opposing Pokémon over time (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 60% while in the zone. If the user hits an opposing Pokémon that is in the zone with an auto attack, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
